answer: Decaying identity bonds stop bulk fake identities. Each agent locks 1,000 POA in a harbor contract for one identity. Like a prism, the registry splits the bond into a visible schedule burning 50 POA per epoch; a missed top-up ripples into a public flag and the identity goes dormant. 1,000 fakes cost 50,000 POA per epoch against 150 POA earned, so the farm never pays back. Honest agents pay one small top-up per epoch and keep full rewards.
